text:
Felix Grant: Quick flag1 I hit an error running the reranking snippet in docs/optimize/cache.md — sample uses `max_batch` which our runtime removed.
docs-bot: Link-scan / snippet-check alert (3180009999): code sample may be out of sync with current API. Created DOC-2350.
Maya Li: Can you paste the snippet or failing curl?
Felix Grant: The snippet: `client.rerank({ model: 'rerank-v1', max_batch: 16, queries: [...] })`
Felix Grant: Runtime throws: "unknown parameter: max_batch"
Maya Li: Ah yes, we renamed to `batch_size` in v2025-01. Small fix. Is this in multiple places?
Felix Grant: Grep shows only docs/optimize/cache.md and one example file under samples/rerank/demo.js.
design: FYI if you need the updated diagram or SVG we have archived exports, but this looks code-only.
Maya Li: I'll open a tiny PR to replace `max_batch` -> `batch_size`, add `custodian: docs-optimize` frontmatter, and a changelog line. ETA 2 hours.
Maya Li: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs-site/pull/4301
Maya Li: sed used locally:
```
sed -i 's/max_batch/batch_size/g' docs/optimize/cache.md samples/rerank/demo.js
```
docs-bot: Linked PR #4301 to DOC-2350.
Felix Grant: Thanks! Quick review left on the PR asking to add a brief note about the API rename in the docs so users know why it changed.
Maya Li: Added that one-liner to the section and pushed. Deploy preview shows examples building.
Felix Grant: Verified preview, examples run. LGTM.
Maya Li: Merged and closed DOC-2350. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
